TC-20/S24.detail: Re-run 16:47 JST after review; both care settings fail. generateNote failed at B's socket (one call, answered at once). Pass: A's dashboard row sampled every 250 ms never showed Note Ready/Complete (Hospital: Pre-Rounded -> Seen, counts 1/0/1/0; Nursing Home stays Not Yet Prepped, counts 1/1/0/0); typed text kept in the box and stored; no note saved; the Encounter tab has no spinner 10 s after the failure. FAIL (both): the chart never shows the UAT words 'Note not generated' - Hospital Encounter tab says 'The encounter dictation is saved, but the formatted note couldn’t be generated and saved. Tap Generate Note & Finish to retry.', NH 'The visit dictation is saved, but the note couldn’t be generated. Check your connection and tap Generate Note & Finish to retry.'; the Note tab says 'No note generated yet. Complete the Encounter tab first.' TC-20 U9 is not gated and quotes the UAT wording, and the matrix oracle is written from it; EFS Q1 / OAT-03 Q3 ask whether other wording may pass - if Quinn accepts the app's wording, only this check changes. FAIL (Hospital): the Post-Round tab shows a disabled button with a spinner, 'Finalizing Encounter Data…', still spinning 10 s later with nothing in flight (PostRoundTab.tsx canFinalize = status === 'note-ready'; any other status renders Loader2). The earlier summary that the tab 'shows only No note generated yet' was wrong. Record-only: the Note tab has no explicit error state (EFS U4b, gated TFA-92595).

Complete the Encounter tab first.' although the encounter was completed. UAT Empty & Failure States state 4 / TFA-94745 state 4, TC-20 U9 (wording question open: EFS Q1 / OAT-03 Q3).
